In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of endothelin‐3 (ET‐3) in the regulation of vascular tone in the guinea pig.
the role of the endothelin system in the regulation of vascular tone and in the control of airway tone and airway inflammation.
the role of the endothelins in the pathogenesis and treatment of asthma.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
endothelin‐ 1 (ET‐ 1) has a number of effects which may be of significance to the pathophysiology of asthma.
ET‐1 has a pro‐inflammatory role in asthma, and therefore, may contribute to its pathogenesis.
ET‐1, via activation of the ETB as well as ETA receptors, can evoke airway contractions as well as pro‐inflammatory effects in the guinea pig lung.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ET‐1 is a pro‐inflammatory agent in the guinea pig lung.
ET‐1 exes its pro‐inflammatory effect by activating the ETB receptors.
endothelin-1 is a potent proinflammatory mediator that may play a role, at least in part, in the pathogenesis and maintenance of the airway inflammatory process in asthma.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ET-1 is not just an airway constrictor.
endothelin-1 is a pro-inflammatory mediator in the lung.
endothelin-1 is a potent pro-inflammatory agent that can contribute to airway inflammation in asthma.
